pick.headline: Israel and Jordan sign a peace treaty
pick.summary: On 26 October 1994 Israel and Jordan signed a peace treaty at the Arava border crossing, with President Clinton in attendance.
pick.significance: Jordan became the second Arab state to make peace with Israel.
